description.en: Adds the "Relay key" account type: accounts of an Anthropic-compatible relay (your own Base URL and key) that serve the built-in anthropic platform (/v1/messages and /v1/messages/count_tokens) together with the other account types of a group. Declares no platform, no endpoints and no prices.
description.zh: 新增"中转 Key"账号类型：Anthropic 兼容中转站的账号（自定义 Base URL 和 Key），与分组里其他类型的账号一起为内置 anthropic 平台（/v1/messages 和 /v1/messages/count_tokens）提供服务。不声明平台、端点和价格。

description.en: Key of an Anthropic-compatible relay. Requests go to <Base URL>/v1/messages with the key in x-api-key.
description.zh: Anthropic 兼容中转站的 Key。请求发往 <Base URL>/v1/messages，Key 放在 x-api-key 中。

texts.baseURLRequired: Base URL of the relay is required / 请填写中转站的 Base URL

reason.en: Register the "Relay key" account type for the built-in anthropic platform
reason.zh: 为内置 anthropic 平台注册"中转 Key"账号类型
